decisions.reason: Cleaning soap is a low-cost, recurring-demand care item that complements the floor range and remains useful after the care line was streamlined by removing Product C.
Maintenance oil is a core accessory for oiled floors with steady repeat sales and clear synergy with the firm's surface treatments.
Moisture-protection underlay is a standard installation accessory that installers and retailers expect alongside the floors.
High-density underlay serves acoustic and performance installations, though it remains the most likely candidate for future consolidation of the underlay range.
The oak parquet line is central to the firm's core business and design range, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
